description: Architectural rule registry for Bizar Harness. Each rule has what/why/fix fields. Rules are run by scripts/check-arch.sh.

rules.description: Plugin must not import from dashboard (cross-layer violation)
rules.what: A file in plugins/bizar/src/ imports from bizar-dash/.
rules.why: The plugin (Layer 0) and dashboard (Layer 1) communicate via the ClineCore SDK. A direct import couples the layers and breaks the plugin's portability (e.g. running inside Cline without the dashboard).
rules.fix: Move the shared code to packages/sdk/ and import from there. The plugin should only depend on @cline/sdk, @cline/core, and packages/sdk/.

rules.description: Plugin must not call dashboard HTTP for memory operations
rules.what: A memory tool in the plugin calls the dashboard's /api/memory HTTP endpoint.
rules.why: The plugin must work without the dashboard running. Memory is on disk at ~/.bizar_memory/ — reading/writing directly avoids a network hop and a runtime dependency.
rules.fix: Use the in-process vault helpers from plugins/bizar/src/memory-vault.ts (readNote, writeNote, listNotes, searchNotes).

rules.description: Plugin must not spawn cline serve subprocess
rules.what: Plugin code spawns the cline serve child subprocess.
rules.why: The subprocess hangs in headless test environments (no cline CLI, no creds). The plugin embeds ClineCore in-process via ClineRuntime instead.
rules.fix: Replace serve.ts with clineruntime.ts; remove the bun.spawn(["cline","serve",...]) call. Use ClineRuntime.startSession / send / abort / subscribe instead.

rules.description: All tools must use createTool from @cline/sdk (no manual AgentTool shape)
rules.what: A tool in plugins/bizar/src/tools/ is hand-rolled instead of using createTool().
rules.why: createTool() handles inputSchema validation, the AgentTool wrapper, and metadata. Hand-rolled tools drift from the Cline SDK contract over time.
rules.fix: Import createTool from @cline/sdk and call it with { name, description, inputSchema: z.object({...}).shape, execute }.

rules.description: No debug artifacts in src/ (console.log / debugger / .only())
rules.check: ! grep -rEn '(console\\.log|debugger|\\.only\\()' plugins/bizar/src packages/sdk/src bizar-dash/src --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' --include='*.mjs' 2>/dev/null | grep -v test | grep -v '\\.test\\.' | head -1; true
rules.what: Debug artifact found in src/ (console.log, debugger, or .only()).
rules.why: Debug artifacts leak into production, slow down startup, and pollute logs. The clean-state check enforces their absence.
rules.fix: Remove console.log/debugger/.only(). Use logger.debug() if logging is intentional. For tests, remove .only() before commit.

rules.description: Memory vault location must be configurable via BIZAR_MEMORY_VAULT env var
rules.what: Memory vault location is hardcoded; BIZAR_MEMORY_VAULT env var not honored.
rules.why: Users may want a different vault location (e.g. project-local .obsidian/). The env var lets them override without code changes.
rules.fix: Use resolveVaultRoot() from plugins/bizar/src/memory-vault.ts — it checks process.env.BIZAR_MEMORY_VAULT first, then falls back to ~/.bizar_memory/.

rules.description: All 17 + 2 = 19 tools must be registered in the plugin entry
rules.what: Fewer than 19 tools registered in the plugin entry.
rules.why: The harness ships 17 core tools + 2 Cline agent team tools = 19. New tools must be added to the buildTools() function in plugins/bizar/index.ts.
rules.fix: Add the tool factory call in buildTools() and import it at the top of plugins/bizar/index.ts.
